description: P25 (plan M6-M9 §2.7, §5.1): The Greywood of level.world; its bounds tile the interior with the other four regions.
m7_note: The woodfolk's wood: Hollowmere on its black pond, where Sedge asks for the Troll Matriarch's end; the troll den in the north-west ridge, the woodcutters' camp, the great pines and the Needle to the Hidden Grove.
